=segments.text:
id: CH09
book: 3
title: Stalemate and Departure (The First Coming)

timeline_anchors:
  - Year 87 M11 D22: Southern Nexus Site (construction assessment)
  - Year 92 M6 D3: Northern Nexus Site (unexpected cooperation)
  - Year 99 M8 D14: Crimson Citadel (final assessment)
  - Year 100 M1 D1: Northern Nexus Site (the morning after)
  - Epilogue: Three millennia hence (records + future foreshadow)

pov_modes:
  - Anunnaki command (Enlil, Eduhauana)
  - Igigi (Pazuzu)
  - Giant (Torhh)
  - Deep archive epilogue voice

narrative_intent:
  Conclude First Coming with partial infrastructure success and strategic withdrawal, while planting the long-resistance seed: victims choosing alliance in the poisoned aftermath.

world_state_changes:
  - Needle network remains incomplete but functional in fragments; multiple sites flagged for Second Coming completion.
  - Anunnaki depart due to orbital constraints; transfer maintenance to Igigi + garrison to Reptilians.
  - Sundering continues as a long-term psychological weapon embedded in populations.
  - Post-departure: a cooperative path is declared possible (Torhh + Pazuzu), even while acknowledging implanted division.
  - Epilogue establishes “deep record preservation” and future coming-cycle stakes.

primary_conflicts:
  - Time vs completion (orbital clock forcing withdrawal).
  - Moral fracture inside the occupation apparatus (Igigi sympathy vs programming).
  - Post-withdrawal survival: build alliance while carrying implanted lies.

entities_introduced_or_activated:
  - Enlil (Overseer): construction status + withdrawal recommendation logic
  - Eduhauana (Queen): final assessment + Second Coming configuration approval
  - Pazuzu (Igigi): collaboration pivot; self-awareness of programming
  - Torhh (Giant): bridge-builder; grief without hate; alliance frame
  - Nephilim-class suppression forces (planned for Second Coming)

mechanics_seeds:
  - Orbital Clock: “cycles remaining” as a hard timer for objectives.
  - Site Completion Matrix: percent completion per Needle site affects network capacity.
  - Morale/Sympathy Drift: Igigi efficiency changes over time with moral alignment.
  - Sundering Pressure: passive “division growth” meter impacting faction trust.
  - Repair Arc: trust can be rebuilt by repeated cooperative actions over long spans.

continuity_flags:
  - Manuscript uses “Neferati” in this chapter; normalize to canon Nephoretti in generated docs (alias).
  - The epilogue references future alliance fracture post-Nephilim Summoning. Track this as a promised later payoff.
